summary: Loan Tracking Module - Full backend + frontend testing. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend: loans nav, list, detail, payment recording, status update all working correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Loan creation form - client search for sipahi
integration_issues.issue: Sipahi can only search KYCs where field_officer_id == their user id. A newly created sipahi user with no KYCs assigned will find no clients in the search. In practice, a sipahi can only create loans for clients whose KYC THEY created. This may limit the workflow if a muneem creates KYC but sipahi needs to create the loan.

issues: Loan Date and Due Date use browser's native date picker (HTML input type=date) instead of a custom calendar component. Inconsistent with the app's design if other forms use shadcn calendar.

action_items: Consider widening KYC search scope for sipahi in loan creation: either search across all KYCs in their assigned illaka, or allow muneem to also search across their assigned illakas. Currently sipahi can only find clients they personally onboarded.
Consider replacing native date inputs with shadcn calendar in loan form for design consistency (minor/optional)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 852 lines - exceeds the 700-line limit. Should be split into modules: loans.py, payments.py, kycs.py, auth.py etc.

In _loan_query_for_user for sipahi: returns {'sipahi_id': user['id']} (correct). But for loan creation, KYC search still uses _kyc_query_for_user which filters by field_officer_id for sipahi. This means sipahi cannot find clients they didn't personally KYC during loan form client search.

add_payment endpoint does NOT gate by loan status - payments can be added to closed/overdue loans. The UI hides the button for non-active loans but the API allows it. Consider adding status check in the backend.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all major flows verified; client search for fresh sipahi users returns no results due to scope limitation

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_sipahi_loans@bahikhata.com sipahi user. Created 1 test loan with TEST Borrower client (principal ₹10,000, 2.5%/month). Added multiple test payments during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loan tracking module fully working. All backend APIs: GET/POST /api/loans, GET /api/loans/{id}, PATCH /api/loans/{id}/status, POST/DELETE /api/loans/{id}/payments. Role gates: admin/maalik/muneem can update status and delete payments. Sipahi can create loans and add payments. Admin CANNOT create loans (403). Dashboard stats include active_loans and total_loans. Test sipahi user: TEST_sipahi_loans@bahikhata.com / Test@1234. Known test loan id visible in loans page.
rca_of_issue: Client search limitation for sipahi: The KYC listing API uses _kyc_query_for_user which for sipahi returns {field_officer_id: user.id}. This scopes KYC search to only the sipahi's own clients. Since the loan form uses the same /api/kycs endpoint, a sipahi creating a loan can only find clients they personally KYC-verified. This is by design in current implementation but may need review for operational workflows where muneem does KYC and sipahi disburses loans.
